header.title: Article Impact Analysis
header.subtitle: In-depth analysis of article impact across three dimensions: academic, social, and practical.

explanation.title: About Article Impact Score
explanation.subtitle: The impact score combines three dimensions of research impact measurement.

academic.title: Academic Impact
academic.desc: Measures citations, SINTA accreditation, and other academic impact indicators.

social.title: Social Media Impact
social.desc: Measures dissemination and discussion of research on social media, news, and blogs.

practical.title: Practical Impact
practical.desc: Measures practical implementation, public policy influence, and direct community benefit.

explanation.data_note: Currently only the academic dimension is computed from the database. Social and practical dimensions require integration with external data sources (Altmetric, etc.).
